ti.title: ዕልል በሉ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ዕልል በሉ ንስእነት ሰላምና
‘’ ‘’ ሎሚ ተኻሒስና
‘’ ‘’ ብርሃን’ውን ረኣና
‘’ ‘’ ብሓያል ኣምላኽና
[[/chorus]]

ዕልል በሉ ንስሙ ዘምሩ
ኣመስግኑ ዕቤቱ ንገሩ
እግዚአብሔር ጻድቕ’ዩ ብግብሩ
እናበልኩም ወትሩ ኣበሥሩ

ዕልል በሉ ከም ሓፍቱ ንሙሴ
‘’ ‘’ ንጀምር ውዳሴ
‘’ ‘’ ብማህሌት ቅዳሴ
‘’ ‘’ ነመስግን ስላሴ

ዕልል በሉ ብጓሳ ነፍስና
‘’ ‘’ ደጊም ሓራ ኢና
‘’ ‘’ ብደሙ ነጺህና
‘’ ‘’ ብሞቱ ድሒና

ti_ro.title: 'Ll belu
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
‘’ ‘’ Nzelalem amen
[[/chorus]]

Ll belu nsmu zemru
Amesgnu betu ngeru
Gziabher tsadq’yu bgbru
Nabelkum wetru abessru
Ll belu nsnet selamna
‘’ ‘’ Lomi tekhahisna
‘’ ‘’ Brhan’wn reana
‘’ ‘’ Bhayal amlakhna
Ll belu kem haftu nmuse
‘’ ‘’ Njemr wdase
‘’ ‘’ Bmahlet qdase
‘’ ‘’ Nemesgn slase
Ll belu nlul amlakhna
‘’ ‘’ Selam zengeselna
‘’ ‘’ Arhiqu tfatna
‘’ ‘’ Mhret zelbesena
Ll belu bgwasa nefsna
‘’ ‘’ Degim hara ina
‘’ ‘’ Bdemu netsihna
‘’ ‘’ Bmotu dhina
Ll belu nkhulu zmelkh
‘’ ‘’ Gziabher ybarekh
‘’ ‘’ Haylu yteamen
